title: Jumbled Sentence 92
subject: History
caption: Flowchart showing the steps to reorder the jumbled parts P, R, Q, S into the correct sequence.
altText: A flowchart that begins with the jumbled sentence 92 and branches to four nodes labeled Part P, Part R, Part Q, and Part S. Each part connects to a node that identifies its grammatical role. All identification nodes converge on a reorder node that arranges the parts in the order P → R → Q → S, which then leads to a grammar‑check node and finally to a node representing the correctly ordered sentence.
